promotion_gate: A composition must have positive mean margins in both-seat development games against ROWAN and its matching SORREL component. Its worse mean margin against pinned Kaito v43 and Igor MultiRoute must be at least ROWAN's worse public-panel mean. Among eligible compositions, maximize that worse public-panel mean; tie-break by mean margin versus lean20.
validation_access: Do not run reserved validation unless development selects exactly one composition.
